title: Read receipt privacy and opt-in controls
description: The spec ships read receipts (deliveryReceipts, readAt, Peer/receipt) with no opt-out, no symmetry rule, and no per-chat granularity. This epic covers the full set of privacy-preserving controls: account-level opt-in, symmetry enforcement, per-chat override, delivered-to-device state distinction, and timestamp coarsening guidance.
notes: Review converged after 3 rounds. Final review: jmap-chat-spec-rix. R1: 5P0+3P1+3P2 fixed. R2: 1P0+1P1+2P2 fixed (burnOnRead causal error corrected). R3: 0 findings. 90% confidence.
